changed_factors: Refine Exponential Moving Prototype Flow (empf-v5 over empf-v4): (1) restore empf-v3's thermal_decay = 0.92 transport smoothing horizon and cool-gated Born-Infeld sharpness gain batch_gain = (2.0 + 3.0 * b_frac) + (1.0 - t_scale) * (4.5 + 12.5 * b_frac) across all continuous dimensions so 1D precision tasks settle within 1000-step suffix windows and 2D multimodal generators (ring16_acquisition, model_ae_gan_multimodal) spread cleanly before thermal cooling engages; (2) retain empf-v4's fixed K = min(max_prototypes, B) small-batch prototype cardinality and variance-normalized / 0.35-deadband stationary zero-shock prototype bank so B=64 VAEs (model_vae_categorical, model_vae_hard) pass stably; and (3) replace unused logsumexp Sinkhorn iterations in unconditioned discrete-simplex and image residual observation with exact unconditioned_chamfer_residual while keeping fused autograd and scalar device-to-host syncs.
mechanism_rationale: Across empf-v3 and empf-v4, two orthogonal mechanisms were isolated: empf-v3 passed ring16_acquisition, model_ae_gan_multimodal, model_vae_hard, precision_gaussian_fp32, and precision_gaussian_mxfp8 under thermal_decay = 0.92 and cool-gated Born-Infeld batch_gain, failing only model_vae_categorical due to K = 64 -> 256 small-batch online prototype growth; conversely, empf-v4 fixed model_vae_categorical and model_vae_hard by removing small-batch online prototype growth, but regressed ring16_acquisition, model_ae_gan_multimodal, and 1D precision settling by switching to thermal_decay = 0.95 and uncooled batch_gain = 6.5 + 15.5 * b_frac under non-peak-hold EMA. Combining fixed K = min(max_prototypes, B) banks and zero-shock stationary normalization with thermal_decay = 0.92, cool-gated batch_gain, and Sinkhorn-free discrete-simplex Chamfer residuals preserves every Tier 1 pass while retaining 1D stability, shift recovery, and deep harmonic-capture hold hysteresis.
